note: First versioned engine: golden baselines for Northbeam (re-baselined after the prototype fixes, PRD §6.8), Northbeam as seeded, and Larkspur Creative.

Rating model (issue #106): detected issues carry a four-level rating (great/good/bad/risk) instead of four severities, rated with the expected wait defaulting to 1 or 2 working days of the model's week; the golden outputs now lock every issue's rating and how it was reached. StepResult gains a p90 field; no simulated number changed.

Market conditions (A57): the engine applies a 24-month market schedule; adds the northbeam-downturn golden model (Northbeam as seeded under Downturn). No existing model's numbers moved: with no market, or Stable throughout, runs are exactly as before.

New analysis rules (issue #107): detected issues now include spare time, work lost at a step, too slow overall, goals met and the absence test (which replaces flagging every one-person step); the golden outputs also lock the absence test's results and the visits each step sends straight to a lost end. StepResult gains lostHere (and p90.lostShare); no simulated number changed.

Client groups (A55): clients can be counted per service and are simulated as unnamed clients; groups that count no clients change nothing; adds the northbeam-groups golden model, and the group churn-risk findings join it. The existing golden models do not move.

Cost per month (issue #108): detected issues carry an estimated cost per month and sort by it within a rating; the golden outputs now lock each issue's cost, and Northbeam's audit step carries a 5% lost-per-day of waiting so its wait insight is costed. The absence test also records wins lost (a weekly won series) for the cost. No simulated number changed.

Churn drivers (A56): each driver's share of churn, pressure and measured value is now reported and locked (churnCauses), rule 10 raises issues with a cost, and a northbeam-drivers golden model runs all ten drivers. No existing simulated number moved: with the default drivers the churn maths is bit-for-bit the old one. Per-client churnMonthly now includes the switched-on drivers and the market's churn factor, so A43's churn-risk costs rise under a market schedule or once a driver is on (northbeam-downturn ratings/costs); load reads only finished work, and onboarding only counts clients with servicing.
Optional payHidden on the engine model and a nullable overtimeCost (B1 per-person privacy, 2/3a): pay-dependent figures can be withheld. No simulated number moved.
Overtime evidence states no money and the overtime_cost metric is gone, so saved issues hold no pay (B1 2b)
MonthlyResult gains mrr and atRisk (B7); no simulated number moved
EnginePerson gains an optional capacityFactor (per-person times, C6 #198): hands-on time × the person's factor. No fixture has one, so no simulated number moved.

Profit first (sandbox phase 2): billed revenue incl. hourly work for clients won in the run, paid labour, overheads and profit, and monthly sales, revenue and money series; northbeam-money golden model. No existing simulated number moved.

Sandbox phase 3: monthly channels, churn drivers as chances, fee ranges, price rises for existing clients with their churn, pinned warm-up option; northbeam-chances and northbeam-channels golden models. No existing simulated number moved.

Sandbox phase 3 review: entered churn-driver chances draw the warm-up's hits (brief Q11), so a client on the book starts the run as likely to be under a hit as later on; only northbeam-chances moves (its handoff and competitor chances). Also: a churn channel reaches every merged client's reported churn, and the overtime limit multiplies in its old order without a capacity channel (1.12.0 moved the last bit of overtime for some models outside the goldens). No other golden value moved.

Time and what it achieves (sandbox phase 4): EngineStep.purpose and MonthlyResult.time (first-pass hands-on hours by purpose, rework, client hours, idle and hours available, per role, person and team); larkspur-time golden model. No existing simulated number moved.
capacity inputs (P2): new golden; no existing number moved
step splits, tier multipliers and changes (P3)
